Name: Additional Sheep
Author: bansaighdear
Description:
Adds a variety of sheep in the colors white, black, grey and moorit (reddish brown) plus the corresponding wool and fabric.

The sheep are:
- Black Bleset
- Grey Bleset
- Black Smirslet
- Moorit Smirslet
- Dark headed white
- Dark headed moorit

The items are:
- Moorit Wool and Cloth
- Grey Wool and Cloth
- Black Wool and Cloth

The icons in Marnie's Shop show the head of the two possible sheep and are grouped as follows:
- Bleset (Grey / Black)
- Smirslet (Black / Moorit)
- Darkheaded (Moorit / White)

There is currently no config to disable certain sheep, so, just don't buy the one's you don't want ...
There is also currently no config to set a different prices.

If you have a sheep recolor that you would like to have as additional, feel free to take my files as some groundwork to figure out how to do it. I'd love to get a shoutout when you're done so I can get more sheep. ( °ᵕ°)

Also, if' you're like to provide a translation: please do and give me a nudge so I can link your translation on this site (or integrate it directly).


Update January 2026: fixed issue where sheep gave the wrong wool

Update February 2026: added tags so that cloth can be used for tailoring and added german translation
